title: add-browser-collab-rag-sandbox-with-wasm-proxy-and-live-asserts-quickstart
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Introduces a browser-collaboration RAG quickstart that runs a light WASM proxy for embedding indexing and local tool stubbing. Useful for demos and local authoring; non-breaking.
description: Adds a new interactive quickstart: a browser-collaboration RAG sandbox that demonstrates using a tiny WASM proxy to host index lookups and tool stubs in the browser for low-friction demos and offline-first authoring. Motivation: teams asked for a compact, reproducible sandbox that shows RAG behavior without requiring a backend server or paid cloud index; this quickstart is intended for workshops, hackdays, and local evaluation. This PR includes: 1) guide and step-by-step quickstart docs with screenshots and a single-command devmode; 2) a lightweight WASM proxy (Rust -> wasm32) used to run a tiny in-memory index & plugin stubs in the browser; 3) an instrumented telemetry shim and live assertion harness so authors can write scenario-based checks that run in CI; 4) an example agent that demonstrates tool-calling (HTTP webhook stub, file-reader tool, and a simple reranker) with streaming output. Checklist: - [x] Quickstart guide written and linked from README - [x] Minimal wasm proxy compiled and included as prebuilt artifact for convenience - [x] Local dev server and devcontainer added for reproducible workshops - [x] Live assertion harness + two canonical scenarios implemented - [x] Unit tests for wasm proxy bindings and TS runtime gluing - [x] Basic telemetry probes and instructions for enabling Redwood console integration Notes on scope: This is intentionally small — the WASM proxy is a dev/demo shim and not recommended for production indexing. The guide calls out migration paths to proper Redwood Dedicated/Private indexing flows. Related: ENG-1729 (interactive authoring), PM-423 (RAG workshop kit).

diff_snippets: + src/index.tsx: added local agent runner that connects to wasm proxy via wasm-bindgen and exposes a ToolRegistry interface
+ wasm-proxy/src/lib.rs: minimal index store (in-memory) + FFI helpers for query and simple rerank
+ README.md: new quickstart guide, prerequisites, and step-by-step commands including 'pnpm install && pnpm dev'
review_comments: Owen Park: Nice compact approach — do we need a prebuilt wasm artifact in the repo? Can we rely on GitHub Releases or CI artifact caching?

Maya Chen (reply): Prebuilt artifact is for workshop friction; CI still builds from source. Added note in README about regenerating the wasm via 'make wasm' and we upload to releases in the release pipeline.
Liam Patel: The live assertion harness is useful but the tests seem flaky on Windows devboxes — can we make the file system paths normalized?
Maya Chen (reply): Good catch. Updated the test harness to normalize paths and added a Windows matrix job to CI to catch regressions.
Sana Idris: Telemetry probes look fine; please ensure no PII leaves the browser demo by accident. Add a clear doc note about redaction and default-disabled remote telemetry.
Maya Chen (reply): Telemetry is disabled by default; documentation updated and console integration steps are gated behind an explicit opt-in. Added mention in security section.
testing_notes: Local verification steps included in README. CI runs: unit tests, wasm build, and a two-step playwright scenario which validates the live assertion harness against canonical scenarios (answers contain expected citations, tool-calls observed in trace). Added a Windows runner to reduce flaky dev discrepancies.
user_impact: Developers and workshop hosts can run an entirely browser-hosted RAG sandbox without cloud indexes. This lowers friction for demos and reproducible debugging but is explicitly labeled as not-for-production in the docs.
migration_instructions: Docs include a 'next steps' section showing how to swap wasm proxy calls with a Redwood Dedicated index endpoint: 1) replace the wasm-proxy adapter with the remote IndexClient; 2) adjust config to set INDEX_HOST and API_KEY; 3) run rollout via console for telemetry continuity.
release_notes_detail: New quickstart: interactive browser RAG sandbox with WASM proxy and assertion harness. Includes prebuilt wasm for workshops, CI workflow, and developer docs. No breaking changes.
maintainer_notes: Keep prebuilt wasm under releases for larger changes. For security updates to wasm bindings, bump the prebuilt artifact and update checksum in README. Consider extracting wasm proxy into a small published crate if reuse increases.
merge_conclusion: After addressing reviewer feedback (prebuilt artifact justification, path normalization, telemetry opt-in) CI was green and reviewers approved. Merged via squash to keep history tidy.
